render_prompt: render a prompt from dict or bytes format into a standardized DictPrompt object
render_prompts: render a sequence of prompts from dict or bytes format into a list of DictPrompt objects
render_messages: render chat messages into conversation messages and a DictPrompt using the model's chat template
tokenize_prompt: tokenize a DictPrompt into a TokPrompt with optional pre and post tokenization processing
render_cmpl: render a sequence of prompts into EngineInput objects with tokenization and arrival time for completion requests
